reasoning: On the season so far the Thunder are the stronger team; with home court the Thunder start about 7 points better, in a game of about 222 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Clippers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Thunder win 67 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 195 and 243 total points.

analyst.text: The Clippers are 2-8 after a 23-point loss in Phoenix, with Bradley Beal yet to play. The one hopeful note is that Brandon Ingram is "pretty close" to his debut after heel surgery. Oklahoma City arrive having lost back-to-back games in Portland and are thin: Ajay Mitchell, Jaylin Williams, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace were all listed out. Both teams have reasons to be irritable. An Ingram debut would give the Clippers a lift, but OKC's urge to bounce back is the stronger pull.
